author: Antigravity
description: A deep dip strategy that targets two specific RSI regimes: Resilient Dips (RSI > 40) or Capitulation Crashes (RSI < 25), while avoiding the 'Bleeding Death Zone' (RSI 25-40). Requires significant negative momentum on the 5-day window.
character: Split Personality (Momentum vs Dip) - Solved by focusing exclusively on the Dip leg.
rule_logic: mom_5d <= -15 AND (rsi >= 40 OR rsi <= 25) AND vol_ratio <= 2.0 AND daily_ch <= -5 AND ema_dist <= 10
discovery_notes: AERGO displayed a 'Split Personality' with both Momentum and Dip rallies.
Momentum rallies were too noisy (precision < 25%) and were discarded.
Dip rallies showed a unique 'Doughnut' pattern in RSI.
Successful dips either maintained RSI strength (>40) despite price crash, OR went into extreme capitulation (<25).
Failures clustered in the RSI 29-37 zone (The Death Zone), representing steady bleeding with no reversal signs.
Volume filtering (Vol < 2.0) helped ensure accumulation rather than panic selling.
